Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/agent_checks.py

src/agent_runtime/agent_checks.py

Python · Tier A

Separate Agent Check enforcement from optional passive monitoring using the accepted run preference. Disposition helpers let evidence owners decide whether to detect; fault publishes bounded, text-free observations while leaving disabled checks non-enforcing. Context-local reporters, strict fact filtering and bounded deduplication keep diagnostics separate from dispatch and model decisions.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
global_mode 49 Read the saved installation monitoring preference, accepting only literal True. With no store or missing preference return the compatibility default False; fresh-install presets are seeded by settings ownership elsewhere.
bind 59 Capture the monitoring bit in context, preferring retained run state, then explicit context, then installation settings. An older saved run without the field stays off rather than adopting a newly enabled global preference.
CheckDisposition 85 Immutable check mode and provenance separating enforcement, passive observation and disabled detection. The record includes both switches plus resolved scope and revision for diagnostics.
disposition 97 Combine the named check's effective enforcement flag with the saved monitoring bit. Enabled checks enforce; known disabled checks observe only when monitoring is true; unknown checks remain disabled.
should_detect 113 Tell an evidence owner whether to run its predicate for enforcement or passive observation. False means both are disabled; this result alone does not authorize blocking or dispatch.
observing 119 Report the passive-only mode for callers that must preserve normal execution while emitting diagnostic evidence.
safe_facts 126 Retain only declared numeric counters within finite nonnegative JavaScript-safe bounds and exact booleans for declared flags. Drop arbitrary text, paths, prompts, unknown keys, infinities and boolean-as-number values before diagnostic publication.
scope 144 Bind conversation state and a reporter or Gateway collector in a ContextVar, inheriting an outer reporter when none is supplied. Always restore the parent binding after the operation; this does not alter enforcement policy.
reporting 156 Bind native entry points that can also be called outside the model loop.
fault 172 For an observed predicate, return true only when enforcement is enabled. Passive mode emits one sanitized catalog-backed event per retained run/check/occurrence identity and keeps at most 128 deduplication hashes; absent reporters produce no event. Reporting errors propagate, and the passive return remains false after a successful report, so observations cannot authorize a blocking branch.
